title: Image upscaler (resampling)
description: Resamples to 2×, 3× or 4× with a high-quality filter plus an adjustable unsharp pass. This is classic resampling — it enlarges what is already there and does not invent detail — and the page says so rather than implying a generative model.
x-privacyfold-engine: none (plain JavaScript in the browser tab)

input.description: An image file (data URI or pasted File) processed in the tab; never uploaded.
